items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury question on the slate; questionable after practicing Friday. Directly impacts Justin Herbert projections and LAC pass game; 4pm ET start.
items.why: Ribs; practiced Friday to earn Q; Levitan flags as slate-biggest for cascade effects.
items.implication: Game-time decision risk; Herbert/LAC WRs (Johnston etc) projections swing hard.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Quentin Johnston and other LAC WRs see target bump vs LV.

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins due to hamstring injury for Week 2 vs Bengals. Missed practice after tweaking it midweek; not believed long-term but official OUT.
items.why: Hamstring tweak in Wednesday practice; DNP Thu/Fri; official ruling.
items.implication: Remove from all lineups; HOU WR/TE volume redistributes.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining HOU pass-catchers including TE Dalton Schultz.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers listed as doubtful for Sunday vs Saints (hamstring). Missed multiple practices; returned limited Friday but low expectation to play.
items.why: Hamstring; second straight DNP then limited; official doubtful.
items.implication: Sit Flowers; BAL WR room thinned with Ja'Kobi Lane also out.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share for Rashod Bateman and remaining BAL WRs/TEs like Mark Andrews.

items.text: Raiders listing TE Brock Bowers as doubtful for Sunday vs Chargers (knee) per HC Klint Kubiak. Returned to practice Friday after meniscus surgery but unlikely.
items.why: Knee/meniscus; practiced Friday but HC doubtful designation.
items.implication: Do not start; monitor for any surprise active but low odds.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer and other LV TEs/WRs gain routes if OUT.

items.text: Patriots desperately need playmakers with AJ Brown on IR; do they give TreVeyon Henderson 10+ touches in 2026 debut? Returning at right time vs PIT with strong upcoming slate before bye.
items.why: Explosive needed; unclear share vs Stevenson but timing + matchups (PIT/JAX/BUF etc) favorable.
items.implication: Flex/RB3 upside if volume materializes; monitor early snaps/carries.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/third-down/explosive carries available in thinned NE backfield/offense.
items.conflict: Still expected committee; Stevenson likely lead.

items.text: BAL, HOU, NE down to crumbs at WR with Flowers/Lane out, Collins OUT, AJ Brown IR. Hierarchy shifts; interested in extended looks elsewhere like Pittman status.
items.why: Multiple key WRs OUT/DOUBTFUL/IR thinning rooms to backups.
items.implication: Avoid thin-room WRs; stream or pivot to TEs/beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: Target vacuum for Bateman/Andrews (BAL), Schultz/Hutchinson (HOU), NE remaining pieces + Henderson.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson listed IN and cleared/full participant all week; set for 2026 debut vs Steelers after missing Week 1 (ankle). Off final injury report.
items.why: Full practices Mon-Fri; removed from IR/report; self said ready.
items.implication: Debut opportunity in desperate NE offense needing explosives (AJ Brown IR).
items.opportunity: Potential 10+ touches in committee with Rhamondre Stevenson; nice upcoming schedule.

items.text: Alvin Kamara listed IN for Week 2; expected back, further squeezing NO RB committee including Travis Etienne.
items.why: Full participant/IN on ETR Sunday list.
items.implication: Kamara reclaims lead role; Etienne/Kendre Miller usage compressed especially in pass game.
items.opportunity: Kamara snaps/routes/RZ; reverse prior Etienne beneficiaries.

items.text: Bengals listing QB Joe Burrow as questionable (back) but Burrow said he would play vs Texans.
items.why: Back injury; official Q but player confirmation of playing.
items.implication: Start with confidence unless late scratch; CIN pass game intact.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: handled 21/24 team RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% routes targeted (tied team lead). Indy just allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Dominant Week 1 usage (24% tgt share) + juicy matchup vs soft IND run D.
items.implication: Must-start RB1; massive season range of outcomes if healthy.
items.opportunity: High snap/target/RZ share in KC offense.

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty (99 util score Week 1 under Kubiak, near Bijan) @ LAC and Bucky Irving (career-high 26% tgt share, all RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell) vs CLE.
items.why: Elite utilization scores/target shares/RZ work in Week 1; favorable matchups.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex starts; Jeanty overreaction to prior injury scare fading.
items.opportunity: Jeanty workhorse util; Irving receiving + RZ edge over Gainwell.

items.text: Giving Christian McCaffrey a bump off Week 1 usage regardless, but Kaelon Black (groin) status does matter for SF RB hierarchy.
items.why: Week 1 usage baseline + Black Q status impacts backup/handcuff role.
items.implication: CMC remains locked elite start; monitor Black for any SF RB2/3 clarity.
items.opportunity: CMC workhorse snaps/carries/RZ if Black limited.

items.text: LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI (37% tgt share from Wentz, strong hist), DeVonta Smith @ TEN (27% share/high aDOT + soft matchup), Dak Prescott vs WAS (home smash, high total), Dalton Kincaid vs DET (69% routes career-high, top util).
items.why: Usage data (tgt/route/RZ shares) + matchup/historical edges; Dak home totals.
items.implication: Priority starts at WR/QB/TE; volume + efficiency spots.
items.opportunity: Jefferson Wentz volume; Smith aDOT; Kincaid elevated routes/snaps; Dak implied points.

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL (Kamara return squeezes role; underdog script), Marvin Harrison Jr vs SEA (8% tgt share Week 1, no RZ, tough D), Brian Thomas Jr @ DEN (limited + tough perimeter D), Harold Fannin @ TB (career-low 14% tgt share).
items.why: Low Week 1 shares + teammate returns/injuries + tough matchups/low implied totals.
items.conflict: Etienne prior volume now reversed by Kamara IN.
